facts.text: The hotel is located at the Flame Towers, overlooking the medieval Old City and the Caspian Sea.
facts.excerpt: Located at the Flame Towers overlooking the medieval Old City and Caspian Sea

facts.text: The hotel's address is Flame Towers, 1A Mehdi Huseyn, Baku, Azerbaijan.
facts.excerpt: Flame Towers, 1A Mehdi Huseyn AZ1006 BAKU Azerbaijan

facts.text: The hotel has a spa with a hammam, saunas and a rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: a first-class spa with hammam, saunas and rooftop pool

facts.text: The hotel's spa is called Carol Joy Spa.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in ultimate relaxation at Carol Joy Spa.

facts.text: Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Caspian Sea or the city.
facts.excerpt: Bathed in natural light from floor-to-ceiling windows, our luxury hotel rooms immerse you in the spirit of Baku with sweeping views of the Caspian Sea or the incredible city.

facts.text: The Caspian Suite is on the 22nd and 28th floors and has double-height windows at the tip of the Flame Tower.
facts.excerpt: On the 22nd and 28th floor, the Caspian Sea Suite offers the best, breath-taking views across the largest enclosed sea in the world, from floor to ceiling, double floor high ceiling windows at the tip of the Flame Tower.

facts.text: Fairmont Gold Signature Suites are on high floors, at the corner of the Flame Towers building, in a uniquely shaped room.
facts.excerpt: Located on high floors, Fairmont Gold Signature Suites are located on the corner of the Flame Towers building, providing a uniquely shaped room

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has two bedrooms and is on the 24th and 25th floors, with floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: the Presidential two bedroom suite is located on the 24th and 25th floor with spectacular views of the Caspian Sea and the city of Baku from floor to ceiling windows throughout the accommodations

facts.text: Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel experience at the hotel.
Fairmont Gold includes complimentary breakfast and afternoon canapes.
Fairmont Gold includes private lounge access.
Accessible rooms have handrails in the shower, no bathtub, and an emergency button by the toilet.
facts.excerpt: No bathtub,handrails in shower,emergency button by the toilet and emergency indicator in bedroom
